item.title: High-Altitude Balloons Tracked Near a Major Earthquake
item.description: Three AeroStar stratospheric balloons were reportedly operating in western Colombia around the time of a 7.4 earthquake, including one that passed near the epicenter hours earlier, though no evidence establishes that the balloons caused the quake.
